title: Team-season modeling panel (abstract)
description: Shape expected by load_metrics_from_csvs + nba_win_rate_pipeline. Values in sample_data are synthetic; real licensed exports may have many more feature columns.

row_unit.description: One row per NBA team per season

filename_year_rule.description: Year is inferred from filename stem (e.g. 2024_metrics.csv -> year=2024) and stored as column year

id_columns.description: Typical: Team (optional rename to team). Season may appear in some exports.

feature_columns.description: Numeric advanced metrics; pipeline auto-selects numeric columns excluding ids, year, and target.
